items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Roy was playing the drum with us at the time we had made those records.

ctx.x: The one who made the records on Columbia. Yeah.

Well, a long while after that, then, um, he was a fella, I don't know, they couldn't get along with him. And then there, this boy, Roy Evans, he came to the band. He played with Sam. And I think he played with Sam until Sam had given up playing music. He died. Sam died. And after that, this boy, he died too. So from that on, I played around the city of New Orleans with different fellows. I played with Kit Howard's band after he had a band. And I played with, uh, George Williams' band. The drummer.
